links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers to acupuncture questions with versus without knowledge graph grounding
links.effect: Integrating AcuKG improved accuracy: GPT-4o 46% to 54% (P = .03); LLaMA 3 17% to 28% (P = .01)
links.quote: When applied to LLMs in answering acupuncture-related questions, integrating AcuKG with GPT-4o and LLaMA 3 significantly improved accuracy (GPT-4o: 46% → 54%, P = .03; LLaMA 3: 17% → 28%, P = .01).

unlisted_practices: Building an ontology-mapped knowledge graph with human-in-the-loop curation as a knowledge resource for research and LLM applications

screen.practice: knowledge graph retrieval grounding for LLM
screen.reason: The study develops a knowledge graph (AcuKG) and empirically evaluates whether integrating it with existing LLMs (GPT-4o, LLaMA 3) via retrieval/knowledge grounding improves QA accuracy compared to baseline LLMs.
